newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Notionnel leans on 129.00 support area.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Notionnel leans on 129.00 support area.

text.p: September notionnel futures traded on the MATIF are struggling to hold above support just below the 129.00 level, with a break there targetting 128.70 and lower, technical analysts said on Wednesday.

The top end of this range from 129.00 down to the June 13 high of 128.94 has already been violated in early trade, with the market reaching a low of 128.96, but trade has now lost the momentum exhibited at the open.
"It's basically stalled here," said Gerry Celaya, senior technical analyst at American Express Bank in London. "If it gets below, there's not to much support."
September notionnel futures were down 0.14 at 129.06 by 0820 GMT.
Celaya said the double top formed in recent trade was continuing to weigh on the market. The next support was pegged at 128.70, the high on June 20, and then 128.42.
"That level is pivotal," said Celaya. "If the market does any damage below there things are going to get very ugly indeed."
He said the market was not particularly oversold, according to the Relative Strength Index. The 14-day RSI was reading 39 percent. A reading below 30 suggests the market is oversold.
On the upside analysts said resistance was at the heavily congested area of 129.50 to 129.60, which also encompasses highs and lows.
A break back above there would improve the technical outlook and target the August 1 low of 130.06, Celaya said.
At the short end, Pibor futures were unchanged at 96.39. Initial support was pegged at 96.37, but it was defeated earlier on. The 96.32 is the next line of defence.
